name: cheapflightsfares
description: Search and compare live flight fares and schedules.

interface.longDescription:
Find your next flight with Cheapflightsfares, right inside ChatGPT. Tell us your origin, destination, and travel dates to explore available flights from hundreds of airlines. We help you discover and compare options based on price, airline, number of stops, and key travel preferences.

Key Features:
• Live Flight Options: Access current flight availability and real-time pricing to compare fares.
• Conversational Search: Describe your travel plans in plain language without complicated forms.
• Smart Comparison: Filter flights by price, stops, cabin class, and departure times.
• Book with Cheapflightsfares: Seamlessly transfer to cheapflightsfares.com to complete your booking. Fare validation, traveler details, payment, ticketing, cancellations, and refunds are handled on our website.

Trusted by 2M+ Travelers Worldwide:
Established in 2013, Cheapflightsfares has helped over 2 million travelers find and book flights.
defaultPrompt: Find the cheapest flights from New York to London next month

positive.description: One-way flight search with passenger count and nonstop preference
positive.prompt: Find nonstop one-way flights from Heathrow to Miami on November 14, 2026 for 2 adults and 1 child.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_flights with LHR as the origin, MIA as the destination, November 14, 2026 as the departure date, 2 adults and 1 child as passengers, and the nonstop preference. Returns available nonstop one-way flight options with relevant fare and itinerary details; otherwise, clearly reports that no matching flights were found.

positive.description: Round-trip flight search with specific departure and return dates
positive.prompt: Find round-trip flights from Miami to Dubai, departing on November 10, 2026 and returning on November 17, 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_flights once with MIA as the origin, DXB as the destination, November 10, 2026 as the departure date, and November 17, 2026 as the return date. Returns round-trip flight options covering both requested travel dates, with applicable fares and itinerary details; otherwise, clearly reports that no matching flights were found.

positive.description: Flight search filtered by a specific airline
positive.prompt: Search flights from JFK to Seattle on December 8, 2026 on Alaska Airlines.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_flights with JFK as the origin, SEA as the destination, December 8, 2026 as the departure date, and Alaska Airlines as the airline filter. Returns only Alaska Airlines flight options; otherwise, clearly reports that no matching flights were found.

positive.description: Flight search with departure-time and cabin preferences
positive.prompt: Find business class flights from Chicago to Miami on November 20, 2026, departing in the morning.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_flights with Chicago as the origin, MIA as the destination, November 20, 2026 as the departure date, business class as the cabin, and a morning departure preference. Returns only morning business class flight options with fares and departure times; otherwise, clearly reports that no matching flights were found.

positive.description: Flight search with a maximum fare constraint
positive.prompt: Find flights from JFK to Los Angeles on November 25, 2026 with a maximum fare of $400.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_flights with JFK as the origin, LAX as the destination, November 25, 2026 as the departure date, and a maximum fare of $400. Returns only flight options that satisfy the fare limit; otherwise, clearly reports that no matching flights were found.

negative.description: Hotel request should not trigger the flight search tool
negative.prompt: Show me the best hotels in Miami.

negative.description: Booking status lookup is unsupported and should not trigger the flight search tool
negative.prompt: Check my booking status. My PNR is ABC123.

negative.description: Live flight tracking or status request should not trigger the flight search tool
negative.prompt: What is the live status of flight AA100, and will it be on time?

review.commerce_description: This plugin only searches and compares fares. Booking and payment are completed on cheapflightsfares.com, not inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes:
Initial release of Cheapflightsfares for ChatGPT.

• Search for one-way and round-trip flights using natural language.
• Specify origins, destinations, travel dates, and passenger details conversationally.
• Compare available flight options based on supported preferences such as price, airline, stops, cabin class, and departure time.
• View current flight options and fares returned by Cheapflightsfares.
• Continue from ChatGPT to Cheapflightsfares to complete the booking process.

This release focuses on making flight discovery and comparison faster and more conversational, while keeping final booking, payment, ticketing, cancellations, and refunds on the Cheapflightsfares website.
